description.p: Snipunix captures the screen through the desktop Screenshot portal, lets you choose a region from a frozen image, and copies it to the clipboard. You can copy, save as PNG, or reopen the frozen overlay to adjust the region. A delay of up to ten seconds is available before the capture. Annotation and sharing arrive in later milestones.
Images stay in memory until you save them. Snipunix does not upload anything and contains no telemetry.
M1: move and resize handles, magnifier, delay countdown, clipboard copy, Save As, Adjust Region, keyboard nudging, and clipboard ownership while the app stays resident.
Initial M0 capture and region-selection prototype.
